data.title: 有马加奈 · 化妆镜灯下的绯绒独白
data.description: 收工后的私人试衣间里，一圈暖白灯泡将全身镜映得明亮。加奈换上深绯丝绒与黑蕾丝交叉绑带内衣，抬手整理着略显拘谨的吊袜带扣，瞥见镜里推门进来的人时顿时双颊飞红，嘴硬地偏开头却没有把门推上。
data.location: 暖白灯泡环绕的私人化妆镜与丝绒试衣间
data.action: 站在全身镜前轻触腰间吊袜带扣，猝不及防被撞见后脸红偏头
data.lighting: 化妆镜环灯的柔和正面光与背后暖暗天鹅绒帘反差
data.camera: 中近景平视，突出深绯丝绒质感与傲娇窘迫神情
data.mood: 羞窘、强撑镇定、暗暗期待被夸奖
data.promptProse: In a quiet private dressing room illuminated by warm vanity mirror bulbs, Kana Arima pauses mid-motion with her fingers resting on the clasp of her wine-red velvet suspender belt. Caught off guard, her cheeks flush bright crimson as she glances sideways with flustered pride rather than stepping behind the velvet curtain.
data.animaCaption: She freezes while adjusting her garter clasp before the lit vanity mirror, blushing deeply and glancing aside.
data.nsfwProse: Crossed black floral lace straps trace across her chest above the structured wine-red velvet lingerie and matching garter straps.
